title: Traditional German Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting beef stew made with tender chunks of beef and a variety of vegetables, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add Ukrainian stew, mushroom, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
